Entities.cs @ stage-3: Order.CustomerId and PlacedAt are `{ get; private set; }`, set only in the constructor; items are added once (`this.items.AddRange(items);`, line 80) and exposed as `IReadOnlyList<OrderItem> Items => items.AsReadOnly()`; OrderItem's ProductId, Quantity, UnitPrice are `private set` initialised from the constructor.
